data.name: Izzat
data.gender_notes: Izzat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A symbol of divine glory and honor. The name Izzat carries the meaning “Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izzat usually hope their child will grow to embody glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the glory of Allah
data.etymology: Izzat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izzat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عزت
in_arabic.long_meaning: العزة هي الشرف و الرفعة و العلو في الشأن، و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و المجد. وردت العزة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "ولي الله الذي أخذ بيدي من الضلالة إلى الرشاد، وأخرجني من الظلمات إلى النور، وجعل لي في السماوات مكانا يعزني فيه". و تعتبر العزة من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث تعبر عن القوة و الشرف.

in_urdu.name: عزت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزت نام کی اصطلاحی معنی ہے شان، علو، اور وقار۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'عزّ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'طاقت' یا 'مدد'۔ قرآن کریم میں بھی عزت کا ذکر ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: "الذين يؤمنون بالله ويعملون الصالحات سيجعلهم ربهم في الجنة عزّا". جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ یہ نام روایتی طور پر استعمال ہوتا چلا آیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इज़्ज़त
in_hindi.long_meaning: इज़्ज़त नाम का अर्थ है सम्मान, उच्च पद और प्रतिष्ठा। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'इज़्ज़' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'शक्ति' या 'सम्मान'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, इज़्ज़त एक महत्वपूर्ण गुण माना जाता है, और इस नाम को भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक रूप से इस्तेमाल किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عزت
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزت د (عزّ) څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د قدرت، لوړوالی او درنښت دی. په قرآن کریم کې عزت په ډیرو ځایونو کې راغلی دی، لکه: "او هغه کسان چې ایمان یې راوړی او صالح کارونه یې کړي، رب یې به دوی ته په جنت کې عزت ورکړي". په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې دا نوم ډیر استعمالیږي.

in_english.name: Izzat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Izzat is derived from the Arabic root 'izz', which means 'power', 'strength', or 'support'. In Islamic tradition, Izzat is considered an important attribute, signifying honor, dignity, and respect. The name Izzat appears in the Quran in various contexts, emphasizing its significance in Islamic culture. Historically, Izzat has been used across Muslim communities worldwide, symbolizing noble qualities and high esteem.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Izzat" holds a significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is often used as a handsome and noble name for boys, reflecting a rich and distinguished heritage. In many communities, displaying "Izzat" or respect and honor is highly valued as an important aspect of social etiquette and tradition. This value extends to protecting the dignity and reputation of one's family, community, and folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Izzat" carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is associated with Allah's immense power, glory, and wisdom. The belief is that Allah bestows "Izzat" upon His beloved servants as a token of His favor and approval. By embodying the qualities of "Izzat," one is able to are more mindful of their responsibilities towards Allah, their community, and their own personal values. Ultimately, living a life of "Izzat" is seen as a means toward drawing closer to Allah and attaining His blessings in both this world and the next.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Glory" symbolizes A symbol of divine glory and honor. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Izzat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of glory.
